items.title: Reply icon on hover for friend message
items.precondition: Signed in as user A; open thread with friend B; B has sent at least one message
steps: Confirm Reply icon appears beside react control
items.expected: Reply lucide icon visible on hover/focus for non-unsent friend messages.

items.title: Composer preview after choosing Reply
items.precondition: Thread open with a friend text message
steps: Click Reply on the friend's message
items.expected: Preview bar shows friend display name + truncated original text; Cancel visible; textarea focused.

items.title: Send text reply shows quote strip in bubble
items.precondition: Reply preview active for a text message
items.expected: Flat thread order; bubble contains quote strip (sender + snippet) above reply body.

items.title: Reply to image message shows thumb in quote
items.precondition: Friend sent an image message (body optional)
items.expected: Quote strip includes small image thumbnail (and caption snippet if present).

items.title: Cancel clears reply state
steps: Send a new message without re-selecting reply
items.expected: Preview gone; sent message has no quote strip.

items.title: Unsent original shows Message unavailable in quote
items.precondition: A reply exists quoting a message you sent
steps: Observe the reply bubble's quote strip
items.expected: Quote strip shows italic 'Message unavailable' — not the old body text.

items.title: Quote works when original is paginated out
items.precondition: Thread with 50+ messages; oldest messages require 'Load earlier'
steps: Load earlier until a specific old message is visible
Reply to that old message and send
Scroll to newest messages without reloading thread
items.expected: Newest reply bubble still shows correct quote strip for the old message.
items.notes: Validates API-embedded replyTo — not client-side lookup.

items.title: Peer receives quoted reply via socket
items.precondition: Two browsers/sessions: user A and friend B in same thread; socket connected
steps: As A, reply to a B message and send
Observe B's thread without manual refresh
items.expected: B sees the new reply with quote strip in real time.

items.title: No Reply on unsent messages
items.precondition: Thread contains an unsent message placeholder
items.expected: No Reply control on unsent placeholders.

items.title: Inbox shows ↩ prefix when last message is a reply
items.precondition: Conversation where the latest message is a reply
items.expected: Snippet starts with ↩ followed by the reply body text (not the quoted original).
